citations.clause: Annex A, Table A.1: WBGT reference values
citations.snippet: Reference WBGT for acclimatised workers: about 33°C at rest, 30°C low, 28°C moderate, 26°C high metabolic rate. A screening value above the reference triggers further assessment.

citations.snippet: 0.675 tCO2/MWh. Moving load in time at a single average factor does not change CO2, so no CO2 saving is claimed for time-shifting.
